Name: Soft Warm Dirt Retexture
Author: Pixe1Moss
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Replaces the default hoe dirt with a soft, warm-toned texture dotted with tiny white and pale blue wildflowers. Designed for cozy, cottagecore farm aesthetics while maintaining gameplay clarity.[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]ose of your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*]Ensure you have the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the mod file.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder directly into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI—the retexture will apply automatically.

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Lay out any steps users must follow to install your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Floral Accents: Adds subtle white and pale blue wildflowers to tilled soil for a gentle, natural look.

• Smart Dry/Wet States: Unwatered soil features evenly spread flowers, while watered soil pushes flowers to the outer edges, keeping the center clear for crops.

• Clear Visuals: Provides a distinct visual contrast between dry and watered dirt, making farm management easier.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer

• SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)

• Content Patcher

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for their tools and support. Enjoy your cozy farm![/color]
